So ushers get a door sheet, and it has what theaters to go to in an order so you can clean each theater after everyone gets out efficiently. Once they left, my manager told me to just stop telling people about how there’s no end credit scene. So Reddit, AITA for telling people there’s no end credit scene or was this just a weird couple?
